entries.en: Hey! You lookin' for the book?
Price non-negotiable. You'll need to pay in full on pick-up.
entries.ro: Prețul nu se negociază. Plătești tot la ridicare.

entries.en: Preem. I've flicked you the address. Come by your lonesome.
entries.ro: Beton. Ți-am trimis adresa. Vino singură.
